Read-only M2 audit complete.

The browser registry has 46 regular schemas plus optional `keating_voice`. It creates every tool first, then filters runtime-supported capabilities; direct workspace mutation is additionally endpoint-gated. `createTool` enforces a top-level closed object schema (`additionalProperties:false`) and converts tool failures into `KeatingToolError`. [web/src/keating/browser-tools.ts:54-145](web/src/keating/browser-tools.ts:54), [web/src/keating/browser-tools/shared.ts:67-182](web/src/keating/browser-tools/shared.ts:67)

### 1. Exact registry grouped by execution boundary

| Group | Tool names |
|---|---|
| Safe/local teaching and local persistence | `deck`, `outputs`, `learner_state`, `timeline`, `due`, `remember_learner_profile`, `set_learner_goal`, `list_learner_goals`, `update_goal_step`, `bench`, `quiz`, `feedback`, `grade_quiz`, `ask_user_question`, `grade_question_checks`, `evolve`, `policy`, `auto_improve`, `improve`, `trace`, `prompt_evolve`, `prompt_eval`, `evaluate_teaching`, `request_teaching_improvement` |
| Browser-only implementation / browser sandbox | `agent_runtime`, `source_edit`, `source_diff`, `run_script`, `validate_source_edit`, `source_snapshot`, `source_restore`, plus browser-rendered `animate` |
| Server/hosted or runtime-adapter dependent | `remote_execute`, `list_project_files`, `read_project_file`, conditional `bash`, `write_project_file`, `edit_project_file`; authenticated server course tools `course_list`, `course_inspect`, `course_create`, `course_update`; provider-backed `generate_image`; optional live-provider `keating_voice` |
| Consolidated workspace interface (delegates to prior tools) | `workspace_inspect`, `workspace_exec`, `workspace_change` |
| Workspace mutation subset | `source_edit`, `source_restore`, `write_project_file`, `edit_project_file`, `workspace_change`; `bash`/`run_script`/`validate_source_edit`/`remote_execute` execute code rather than merely mutate files |

Important nuance: `animate` does no remote fetch in its tool handler; it persists model-authored Hyperframes HTML for a sandboxed browser iframe. It is nevertheless not valid native parity because mobile explicitly forbids model-authored HTML/JS and has no animation playback. `generate_image` does make a configured OpenAI-compatible/hosted request. [web/src/keating/browser-tools/media.ts:235-319](web/src/keating/browser-tools/media.ts:235), [web/src/keating/browser-tools/media.ts:322-477](web/src/keating/browser-tools/media.ts:322), [mobile/src/lib/system-prompt.ts:25-40](mobile/src/lib/system-prompt.ts:25)

### 2. Exact schemas and durable side effects

Notation: `s` string, `n` finite number, `i` integer, `b` boolean, `A<T>` array, `O{}` object. `!` marks required. All unspecified fields are optional. This is the exact emitted top-level JSON object shape.

- `agent_runtime {}` — reads active browser/runtime capability config.
- `remote_execute {operation:s!, payload:O{…}}` — NodePod operation or `POST {operation,payload}` to `<executionEndpoint>/execute`.
- `animate {topic:s!, kind:"hyperframes", summary:s, body:s!, storyboard:s}` — saves animation/storyboard/scene/manifest to browser storage; emits `<keating-animation>`.
- `generate_image {title:s!, subtitle:s!, prompt:s, kind:s, imageModel:s, size:s, quality:s, points:A<s>!, labels:A<s>, style:s}` — starts/progresses a remote image-generation request; returns `<keating-image>` with base64 data. It requires three non-generic points.
- `deck {topic:s!, title:s, description:s, cards:A<O{front:s,back:s,tags:A<s>}>!}` — validates, creates/updates a local SRS deck, emits `<keating-deck>`.
- `outputs {}` — reads artifact list.
- `learner_state {}` — reads learner profile, feedback, topics, beliefs.
- `timeline {}` / `due {}` — derive local timeline/due topics from learner state.
- `remember_learner_profile {category:"motivation"|"communication-preference"|"learning-preference"|"interest"!, value:s!, source:"explicit"|"observed"!, evidence:s!, confidence:n}` — persists a profile belief.
- `set_learner_goal {title:s!, description:s, motivation:s, target_date:s, topic:s, steps:A<O{title:s,description:s,kind:s,topic:s,success_criteria:A<s>}>}` — builds and persists a goal; emits `<keating-goal>`.
- `list_learner_goals {status:s}` — reads goals.
- `update_goal_step {goal_id:s!, step_id:s!, status:s!}` — persists `not_started|in_progress|done`; emits updated `<keating-goal>`.
- `bench {topic:s}` — runs pure benchmark over stored outcomes and persists benchmark/report.
- `quiz {topic:s!, questions:A<O{question:s!,type:"multiple_choice"|"short_answer"|"true_false"|"fill_in"|"transfer",level:"recall"|"comprehension"|"application"|"analysis"|"transfer",options:A<s>,blanks:A<O{placeholder:s,hint:s}>,correctAnswer:s!,correctAnswers:A<s>,explanation:s!,rubric:s}>!, adaptive:b, reframes:A<s>, limits:O{question_chars:n,answer_chars:n,explanation_chars:n,rubric_chars:n,option_chars:n}}` — requires two valid authored questions; saves quiz artifact and emits `<keating-quiz>`.
- `feedback {signal:"up"|"down"|"confused"!, topic:s}` — appends feedback signal.
- `grade_quiz {result_id:s!, grades:A<O{question_id:s!, verdict:"correct"|"partial"|"incorrect"!, note:s}>!}` — emits `<keating-quiz-grade>` for UI/result update; does not itself grade by string match.
- `ask_user_question {topic:s, question:s, choices:A<s>, items:A<s>, multi_select:b, allow_text:b, type:"choice"|"text"|"blanks"|"classification"|"matching", blanks:A<O{placeholder:s,hint:s}>, require_reasons:b, unique_matches:b, correct_matches:A<s>, item_label:s, choice_label:s, reason_label:s, hint:s, intro:s, questions:A<O{header:s,question:s,choices:A<s>,items:A<s>,multi_select:b,allow_text:b,type:s,blanks:A<O{placeholder:s,hint:s}>,require_reasons:b,unique_matches:b,correct_matches:A<s>,item_label:s,choice_label:s,reason_label:s,hint:s}>}` — emits `<keating-question>`.
- `grade_question_checks {topic:s!, results:A<O{question:s,verdict:"correct"|"partial"|"incorrect",misconception:s}>!}` — persists grades for matching pending question checks.
- `evolve {topic:s}` — requires enough real outcomes; MAP-Elites evolution; persists active policy and evolution artifact.
- `policy {}` — reads current policy.
- `auto_improve {topic:s, force:b}` — persists baseline benchmark, evolved policy, prompt evolution, final benchmark, improvement attempt; may revert regressed policy and snapshot NodePod.
- `improve {action:s}` — reads improvement archive when `history`, otherwise proposes from a benchmark; no direct persistence in normal proposal path.
- `trace {type:"benchmark"|"evolution"|"all"}` — reads histories.
- `prompt_evolve {name:s}` — evolves, persists prompt evolution, changes in-memory system prompt.
- `prompt_eval {prompt:s!}` — pure prompt evaluation.
- `evaluate_teaching {kind:"evidence"|"prompt"!,topic:s,prompt:s,hypothesis:s}` — delegates to `bench` or `prompt_eval`, no extra write.
- `request_teaching_improvement {scope:"policy"|"prompt"|"both"!,hypothesis:s!,topic:s,target_objectives:A<s>}` — delegates to `evolve`, `prompt_evolve`, or `auto_improve`.

Courses:

- `course_list {}` — authenticated course-library read.
- `course_inspect {course_id:s}` — authenticated course/revision/permissions read.
- `course_create {title:s!,description:s,outcomes:A<s>,modules:A<O{title:s!,description:s,lessons:A<O{title:s!,summary:s,objectives:A<s>,reading:s,estimated_minutes:i,exercise_prompt:s,exercise_rubric:A<s>}>}>}` — server-side durable course create.
- `course_update {action:"update_course"|"upsert_module"|"upsert_lesson"|"upsert_assignment"|"upsert_artifact"|"upsert_card"!,course_id:s,module_id:s,lesson_id:s,assignment_id:s,artifact_id:s,card_id:s,title:s,description:s,outcomes:A<s>,summary:s,objectives:A<s>,reading:s,estimated_minutes:i,exercise_prompt:s,exercise_placeholder:s,brief:s,deliverables:A<s>,rubric:A<s>,due_at:s,estimated_hours:n,artifact_kind:enum,artifact_format:enum,content:s,front:s,back:s,tags:A<s>}` — one recoverable server course addition/revision; never remove.

Workspace:

- `source_edit {file:s!,search:s!,replace:s!,reason:s}` — NodePod VFS replacement; creates snapshot, may emit generated JS counterpart.
- `source_diff {}` — NodePod baseline/current diff.
- `run_script {code:s!,filename:s}` — NodePod JS execution.
- `validate_source_edit {file:s!,testScript:s!,autoRollback:b}` — NodePod test with optional rollback.
- `source_snapshot {label:s}` — NodePod snapshot.
- `source_restore {id:s,data:O{}}` — NodePod VFS restore.
- `list_project_files {path:s}` / `read_project_file {path:s}` — host project endpoint reads.
- Conditional `bash {command:s!,args:A<s>,cwd:s,timeoutMs:n}` — host command endpoint execution.
- Conditional `write_project_file {path:s!,content:s!}` — host overwrite/create.
- Conditional `edit_project_file {path:s!,search:s!,replace:s!}` — host exact-one-match replacement.
- `workspace_inspect {requests:A<O{operation:"list"|"read"|"diff"!,path:s}>!}` — batch delegates to project/NodePod/remote reads.
- `workspace_exec {commands:A<O{command:s!,args:A<s>,cwd:s,timeout_ms:n}>!}` — sequential delegate; stops on first failure.
- `workspace_change {edits:A<O{path:s!,search:s!,replace:s!,reason:s,test_script:s}>!}` — delegates to remote/NodePod/host edits and validates where supplied.
- Optional `keating_voice` is registered only when speech is enabled; it is a live-provider surface, not a generic safe tool.

Schemas/side-effect sources: teaching [web/src/keating/browser-tools/teaching.ts:17-349](web/src/keating/browser-tools/teaching.ts:17), assessment [assessment.ts:49-460](web/src/keating/browser-tools/assessment.ts:49), improvement [improvement.ts:89-437](web/src/keating/browser-tools/improvement.ts:89), courses [courses.ts:510-697](web/src/keating/browser-tools/courses.ts:510), workspace [workspace.ts:36-748](web/src/keating/browser-tools/workspace.ts:36).

### 3. What Mobile can actually execute today

There is currently no mobile tool executor. Provider-emitted calls are recorded as trace events only; provider requests send no `tools`/function schemas. The native prompt instead asks the model to emit interactive tags/OpenUI inline. [mobile/src/lib/system-prompt.ts:4-40](mobile/src/lib/system-prompt.ts:4), [mobile/src/state/KeatingProvider.tsx:484-495](mobile/src/state/KeatingProvider.tsx:484), [mobile/src/lib/provider-client.ts:188-198](mobile/src/lib/provider-client.ts:188)

Existing native/pure primitives make these first-wave handlers feasible without networking beyond the already-selected chat provider:

- Deterministic study generation: stable `resolveTopic`, `buildLessonPlan`, `buildConceptMap`, `generateQuiz`, Markdown serialisers; current UI uses them for offline plans/maps/quizzes. This is equivalent to a proposed mobile-local `plan`/`map`/deterministic `quiz` capability, but those names are not web tool schemas today. [mobile/src/lib/keating-core.ts:8-19](mobile/src/lib/keating-core.ts:8), [mobile/src/lib/learning-artifacts.ts:18-56](mobile/src/lib/learning-artifacts.ts:18), [mobile/test/learning-artifacts.test.ts:5-31](mobile/test/learning-artifacts.test.ts:5)
- `deck`: exact local contract-backed complete-deck/SRS creation exists (`createDeckWithCards`) and supports atomic persistence through the provider/repository path. [mobile/src/lib/learner-decks.ts:105-165](mobile/src/lib/learner-decks.ts:105), [mobile/src/state/KeatingProvider.tsx:1029-1054](mobile/src/state/KeatingProvider.tsx:1029)
- `set_learner_goal`, `update_goal_step`, interactive `quiz`, `ask_user_question`: equivalent OpenUI/tag projection and atomic learner-record mutations exist. `grade_quiz` remains only partially supported because open-ended responses intentionally remain pending teacher grading. [mobile/src/lib/learner-mutations.ts:124-255](mobile/src/lib/learner-mutations.ts:124), [mobile/src/lib/interactive-learning-records.ts:79-164](mobile/src/lib/interactive-learning-records.ts:79), [mobile/src/lib/ui-action-mutations.ts:63-194](mobile/src/lib/ui-action-mutations.ts:63)
- Read-only native equivalents of `outputs`, `list_learner_goals`, `due`, and portions of `timeline`/`learner_state` can derive from the portable repository, review queue, learner-progress dashboard, and local artifacts. [mobile/src/lib/learner-study.ts:149-266](mobile/src/lib/learner-study.ts:149)
- `bench`, `evolve`, `prompt_eval`, `prompt_evolve`, `policy`, `trace`, and `auto_improve` are *portable algorithmically* because `web/src/keating/core.ts` is dependency-free and contains benchmark/MAP-Elites/prompt functions, but Mobile currently only re-exports lesson/map/quiz functions and has no active-policy/prompt/evolution tool-state adapter. Treat these as “needs a local adapter + persistent state,” not as implemented. [web/src/keating/core.ts:1152-1656](web/src/keating/core.ts:1152), [web/src/keating/core.ts:1843-1943](web/src/keating/core.ts:1843), [mobile/src/lib/keating-core.ts:8-19](mobile/src/lib/keating-core.ts:8)

### 4. Recommended M2 initial registry

Use a complete canonical catalog of all 47 web names with per-tool `available | unavailable` and a recovery reason/action. Advertise only currently available schemas to providers; retain unavailable descriptors locally and produce an explicit structured unavailable result if a stale/replayed call arrives. This preserves future parity without misrepresenting mobile capability.

Initial available native schemas:

`deck`, `quiz`, `ask_user_question`, `set_learner_goal`, `update_goal_step`, `list_learner_goals`, `outputs`, `learner_state`, `timeline`, `due`, and a constrained `feedback` mapped to explicit native feedback evidence. Add `grade_quiz` and `grade_question_checks` only once M2 defines exact pending-record mutation semantics and an idempotency receipt; do not silently score semantic answers.

Recommended local extensions, clearly marked mobile-specific rather than falsely claiming web parity: `plan`, `map`, `review_card`, `set_study_priority`, `save_artifact`. Existing deterministic/repository functions support them now.

Explicit initial unavailable statuses:

- `animate`: “Model-authored HTML/JS playback is not supported on mobile; create a Markdown/Mermaid study artifact or hand off to Web/Desktop.”
- `generate_image`, `keating_voice`: “No configured native generation/live transport; open Settings or hand off.” Do not fake output.
- `course_*`: “Requires authenticated course server/session; use Courses sign-in/retry.” The present mobile client is read-only and not a tool loop.
- `agent_runtime`, all `source_*`, `list_project_files`, `read_project_file`, `bash`, `write_project_file`, `edit_project_file`, `workspace_*`, `remote_execute`: unavailable until M2’s authenticated remote adapter exists. Never offer device-local source writes as a substitute. M2’s required outcome is remote read/execute/patch with learner-visible diff confirmation, snapshot/rollback, exactly-once effect IDs, and recovery.
- Improvement tools should initially be unavailable unless the implementation also adds real-outcome projection, active policy/prompt persistence, deterministic run history, cancellation, and exactly-once receipts. A “pretend benchmark” would violate the project’s actual-run evidence rule.

The planned acceptance gate explicitly requires tool/text interleaving, malformed calls, cancellation/background/retry, exactly-once effects, truthful remote workspace capabilities, confirmed diffs, snapshot/rollback, and unavailable recovery. ### 5. Trust/security facts to retain in M2

Web classifies all registered names; trusted text calls are allowed without confirmation, but unknown tools fail closed; untrusted provenance cannot initiate code execution/destructive actions; voice cannot call code execution/destructive or secret-bearing tools. Copy these as policy invariants even though initial Mobile has no execution-capable workspace tools.
